worldcombat.skill.smackdown.summary: Throw a weighted bolt at one target: a foe that is airborne or flying is dragged down to the ground, stripped of its flight and pinned for a while; an ordinary grounded foe just takes the stone.
worldcombat.skill.smackdown.use.0: Knock an airborne foe out of the sky
worldcombat.skill.smackdown.use.1: Break a dive or a levitation
The bolt deals about %1$s damage, about ×1.35 against an airborne target. The target's defence, type matchup and criticals settle at impact.

If the target is airborne or a flyer, the bolt drags it to the ground below, interrupts its interruptible action, strips its flight and pins it for %1$s: throughout, it is held down and any new flight is stripped again every 10 ticks, so it cannot take off; the pin ends when it expires or is cleared.
Castable on a target within %1$s blocks; the bolt flies at %2$s blocks per tick, begins steering toward the target after 2 ticks at up to 5 degrees per tick, and flies for at most 6 seconds.
The bolt's body radius is %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.smackdown.flyers.on: Flyers only on: the companion throws only at airborne, flying or levitating foes, saving the bolt for air defence.
worldcombat.skill.smackdown.flyers.off: Flyers only off: it also serves as an ordinary ranged stone against any foe.
worldcombat.skill.smackdown.timing: Castable on a target within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s s prepare it spends %4$s PP; it recovers for %3$s s and its cooldown starts on commit for %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.smackdown.growth.0: At level %1$s the bolt's power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.smackdown.growth.1: At level %1$s the bolt's power rises to %2$s and the pin lasts %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.smackdown.preference.a: On: the companion throws only at airborne, flying or levitating foes, saving the bolt for air defence. Off: it also uses this as an ordinary ranged stone.
The companion throws only when a threat is this close; lower strikes only up close, higher reaches further.
